//----- Regenerated by session tooling from the final patched project.json -----------------------------------------

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Control.Wait('2');
  Sound.Play(Phone Guy Greeting);
}

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Wait Until ((time == '1 AM'));
  Sound.Play(Phone Guy Hour 1);
  Wait Until ((time == '2 AM'));
  Sound.Play(Phone Guy Hour 2);
  Wait Until ((time == '3 AM'));
  Sound.Play(Phone Guy Hour 3);
  Wait Until ((time == '4 AM'));
  Sound.Play(Phone Guy Hour 4);
  Wait Until ((time == '5 AM'));
  Sound.Play(Phone Guy Hour 5);
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(phone warning)
{
  warning = Random(math_number({'NUM': ['1']}), math_number({'NUM': ['4']}));
  If ((warning == '4'))
  {
    Sound.Play(Phone Guy Warning 4);
  }
  If ((warning == '3'))
  {
    Sound.Play(Phone Guy Warning 3);
  }
  If ((warning == '2'))
  {
    Sound.Play(Phone Guy Warning 2);
  }
  If ((warning == '1'))
  {
    Sound.Play(Phone Guy Warning 1);
  }
}

Phone Guy Hour 4.mp3
